notes.notes:
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25986882/ad127cafe8380ee4ae07669e1a5ec34f19b9b0e7.jpg

Dear Steamers:

In order to celebrate the traditional Mid-Autumn Festival (4th Oct) and Chinese National Day, a -40% discount for Bai Qu is available from 10am 29th Sep PDT, and will last for 2 weeks.
DLCs like digital artbook will be published in the same time.

And we received an announcement from Vavle, saying that several new currencies and 1 new region was added. We noticed that the new game pricing plan actually increased some regions' game price. So after this sale, we will decrease the base price of Bai Qu to avoid any unexpectable increase on our game's price. For further info, please follow up the newest announcements. Thank you.

For Russian translation:
We are sorry that we suspended Russian language's translating progress, for the translators are verified a machine translator. For further info, please follow up the newest announcements. Thank you.

■ Version 1.06
● Redraw all character sprites.
● Updated some CGs.
● Update Ren'Py engine to 6.99.13.
　* This update will fix the clash between Voice Sustain and Voice Playback in Log.
● Add the toggle button of Voice Sustain, next to Voice Volume.

notes.title: Initial Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Customers:

　I am glad to announce you the new work of Magenta Factory, Bai Qu, will published on Steam platform at 8pm PDT on Thursday, July 27th. The price is for USD 15 each.

　Follow the timeline of Shan Gui, Bai Qu also tells a fantastic story in the daily life of the ancient Chinese city of Nanjing. It takes us more than five years to finish it, wish you would love the story. We know our work isn’t perfect, if you encountered any program bug or have any suggestion, please contact us through Steam or by e-mail (baiqu@cngal.org).

　At the time of the first issuing, we provide three language versions: English, traditional Chinese, simplified Chinese. Besides, we also prepared another versions like Japanese, Russian, French, German and Spanish. Since the amount of work is giant, these versions cannot catch the first issuing. We are sorry about that, but we promise the game will be updated as soon as each language version finished, the same with new DLC. Please be patient.

　Anyway, wish you enjoy this journey to our magenta fairytale.
